name: dev-agents
description: Seven subagents with the model tier bound per role, so read-only exploration runs on haiku and real design judgement runs on opus. Includes a delegation strategy skill that says which agent to pick and how to brief it, plus five reminder hooks: one when the main thread has been grinding alone too long, a pair that asks for a task plan before a subagent is dispatched so a long run plus context compaction cannot lose your remaining steps, one that reads what the dispatch actually returned, so an interrupted, empty or blocked subagent is not mistaken for a finished one, and one that catches a shell command whose only job is to pull content into context and points at the tool that would read a slice instead. Does NOT replace /model opusplan, which moves implementation to a cheaper tier but only while plan mode is active; see the skill.
